reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 10 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Wizards.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 77 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 199 and 248 total points.

analyst.text: Houston are shorthanded: Marcus Smart is serving a three-game suspension for punching Charles Bassey, and Fred VanVleet sits the first night of the back-to-back, with Steven Adams and Clint Capela also out. Washington have lost six straight, and Trae Young said the problems are 'more than just effort... a lot of mental things'. The news slightly narrows the gap, but Washington's confidence is low.
